name: Cash in Hand
description: Physical cash held at the shop

name: Bank Account 2 - ICICI Current A/c
description: Secondary bank account (payroll and online sales)

name: Accrued Interest Receivable
description: Interest earned on loan given but not yet received

name: Inventory
description: Goods held for resale (perpetual weighted-average cost)

name: Prepaid Rent
description: Rent paid in advance and not yet consumed

name: Input GST Credit
description: Recoverable GST paid on purchases and expenses

name: Salaries Payable
description: Net salaries accrued but not yet paid

name: Bank Loan
description: Loan availed from a bank (principal only)

name: Accrued Expenses
description: Expenses incurred but not yet paid (e.g. accrued loan interest)

name: Current-Year Profit or Loss
description: Computed from income and expense accounts - never posted directly

name: Interest Income
description: Interest on bank balances and loan given
